caption: The drawing features two views of the same object, a small dish with a decorative handle, known as a porringer. One view is a top-down perspective, showing the round, shallow bowl with concentric circles at the base and a handle decorated with ornate scrollwork and geometric shapes at the top. The second view is a side perspective, illustrating the depth of the bowl and the raised edges, with the same decorative handle extending from one side. The object is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance. The drawing is on a beige background, and in the lower right corner, a handwritten note identifies the object as a "Porringer" and provides its dimensions: length 5 inches, width 3 1/4 inches, and depth 1 3/16 inches, along with a reference to the Boardman Collection, and the years 1790–1850.
title: Pewter Toy Porringer
